name: Harbor
officialNamePolicy: Use only Harbor as the game title. Steam App ID 2714930 and theharborgame.com identify this specific game.
verificationPolicy: Facts are checked against current first-party CastilvaGames and Harbor material, the official Steam App 2714930 listing, Wandering Wizard's official website, and its Steam publisher page. Unknown details are not estimated, and changeable claims must be reverified before reuse.

release.model: Steam Early Access; Epic Games Store release planned
notes: No exact release day or month is currently announced.
No launch price is currently published.
The Steam Early Access Q&A says the full version is expected to cost more than the Early Access version, but no amount is listed.
A free demo ran 24 February - 28 March 2025 during Steam Fest and was temporarily removed in July 2025; a Prologue is planned with no announced date.
Some third-party game databases publish a placeholder exact date such as 27 February 2026. That date is not official.

demo.context: Free demo offered during Steam Fest.
demo.successor: CastilvaGames has said a portion of the Early Access version will be released again as a Prologue.
demo.note: Third-party videos labelled "Harbor demo" show the removed early-2025 build and do not indicate a demo playable today.

storefronts.name: Steam

storefronts.name: Epic Games Store

platforms.note: Official Harbor material lists Steam and Epic Games Store as planned PC storefronts. The official Epic product URL will be added when public.

setting: A post-apocalyptic open-world wasteland built around scarce resources and one safe zone called Harbor.

gameplay.coreObjective: Survive and protect the limited resources collected in the wasteland.
confirmedSystems: Crafting tools, weapons, clothing, and essential equipment
High-stakes death where carried progress can be lost

safeZone.name: Harbor
safeZone.status: The game world's only safe zone

gameplay.vehicleFact: Vehicles are required to catch the War Truck and train that provide valuable resources.

namedLocations.name: Harbor
namedLocations.description: The game world's only safe zone, used for missions, trading, restocking and temporary safety.

namedLocations.name: The Harbor Bar
namedLocations.description: Gathering point inside the safe zone where survivors trade and broker deals.

namedLocations.name: King of the Hill
namedLocations.description: Sanctioned fight events held inside the safe zone.

namedLocations.name: The Citadel
namedLocations.description: Cliffside location holding the master water valve.

namedLocations.name: Diesel Ring
namedLocations.description: The only refuelling location on the map.

namedLocations.name: Blackrail
namedLocations.description: Train line crossing the wasteland; its cars shelter players from radiation.

namedLocations.name: The Bullet Quarry
namedLocations.description: The richest alloy deposits in the wasteland, reached by mine cart.

namedLocations.name: Greenwound
namedLocations.description: Irradiated region that requires Clean Blood to survive.

namedLocations.name: Blackmire
namedLocations.description: Swamp region crossed using the harpoon.

namedLocations.name: Rulers of the Harbor
namedLocations.description: The only ground in Harbor a clan can claim and hold.

gameplay.developmentUpdates2025: Steam development updates published in 2025 covered a gyrocopter vehicle and a rebuilt construction system with three-tier material upgrades.

minimum.processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
minimum.graphics: Compatible GeForce GTX 1080-2070 3GB+ or AMD equivalent, as currently written on Steam

recommended.processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X
recommended.graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

systemRequirements.bootProtection: Secure Boot and TPM 2.0 are listed as required
systemRequirements.changeWarning: Requirements may change during development; the official Steam page is the controlling source.

comparisonBoundaries.affiliations: Harbor is an original game and is not affiliated with Rust, DayZ, SCUM, Mad Max, Fallout, or their owners.
comparisonBoundaries.quality: Harbor is unreleased and has no public user reviews, so superiority or final-quality claims are unsupported.
comparisonBoundaries.zombies: Zombies or infected enemies are not identified as Harbor's defining threat in the current official Steam description.
